summary: This document defines an ACME profile letting the holder of an identifier, such as a domain name, let a third party obtain an X.509 certificate for it, where the key is controlled by the third party. A main use case is a CDN terminating TLS for a content provider, with the owner able to revoke the delegation.

eli5.summary: A website owner can hand a trusted helper a permission to get an ID card for the website. The owner can take that permission back at any time.

questions: how can a cdn get a certificate for my domain
